# Generated items

Generated items, generated by the `feature` schematic (docs/adding-a-feature.md): a
record of modules/records, declared in `generated-item.record.ts`.

## Routes

- `POST /v1/generated-items`, `GET /v1/generated-items`, `GET|PATCH|DELETE /v1/generated-items/{id}`, `POST /v1/generated-items/{id}/restore`
- Permissions on `GeneratedItem`: read, create, update, delete, restore (editors their own, viewers all, unit leads their units')

## Add-ons

Each is one import in `generated-items.module.ts`; its README in `src/modules/<name>` has its routes.

- tags: labels set per record, `?tag=` on the list
- comments: threads, mentions and replies on a record
- attachments: files on a record, scanned and stored on the private disk
- revisions: history of every change, comparable and restorable
- favorites: people pin records they open often
- recents: the records a person opened lately
- templates: saved values that prefill a create
- choices: a field chosen from a provider (its first enum field)
- custom-fields: fields administrators add at runtime
- computed-fields: values derived by an expression on every read
- approvals: actions that need approval before they run (--approvals)
- acknowledgments: "I have read this", per version
- bulk: delete, restore or change many at once
- merge: find duplicates and merge them (needs the recycle bin)
- data-transfer: exports to and imports from CSV or Excel
- data-quality: scans for missing values, duplicates and broken rules
- shares: read-only links to one record
- documents: a record's PDF, from templates/<item>.html
- ai: summarize or classify a record with a language model
- automations: tenants' rules on a record's changes
- sequences: a human-readable number on each record
- webhooks: a record's changes as webhooks for API clients
- notifications: watching a record, and its watchers told of changes
- recurrence: records created on a schedule
- retention: records purged after the days a tenant sets
- mcp: tools for AI agents (MCP): list, get, create, update, delete

## Business logic

- `generated-items.service.ts`, where it says "Business logic"; logic of every write in a `@RecordExtension()` provider of this folder.
- `generated-item.policy.ts`: abilities of its own; `generated-item.permissions.ts`: fields granted one by one, conditions.
- `generated-item.choices.ts`: the choices a writer may pick.
- `generated-item.computed.ts`: the computed fields.
- `generated-item.approvals.ts`: what each approvable action does.
- `templates/generated-item.html`: the PDF.

Tests: `generated-items.e2e-spec.ts`. Remove: delete this folder and its line in `app.module.ts`, then generate the migration that drops its table.
